title: Elixir of Bloodlust
summary: Until Long Rest, once per turn on killing a foe, gain 5 temporary HP and an extra Action.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, once per turn on killing a foe, gain 5 temporary HP and an extra Action.
fields.Stacking: Replaces other normal elixirs and can be overwritten by another.
fields.Crafting: Combine Ashes of Worg Fang with any Salt.
fields.Honour Mode: The extra Action does not support Extra Attack in Honour Mode. Knockouts, Cull the Weak kills and kills from Nyrulna’s area damage do not trigger Bloodlust.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
